122: function thaumaturgyCheck(self)
123: 	if self:attr("archmage_widebeam_always") then return true end
124: 	if not self:attr("archmage_widebeam") then return false end
125: 	local inven = self:getInven("BODY")
126: 	if not inven then return true end
127: 	if not inven[1] then return true end
128: 	if inven[1].type ~= "armor" or inven[1].subtype ~= "cloth" then return false end
129: 	return true
130: end
131: function thaumaturgyBeamDamage(self, dam)
132: 	local v = self:attr("archmage_beam_dam_mult")
133: 	if not v then return dam end
134: 	return dam * (1 + v / 100)
135: end

139: function necroArmyStats(self)
140: 	local stats = {nb=0, nb_skeleton=0, nb_ghoul=0, list={}}
141: 	if not game.level then return stats end
142: 	if not game.party or not game.party:hasMember(self) then
143: 		for _, act in pairs(game.level.entities) do if act.summoner == self and act.necrotic_minion then
144: 			stats.nb = stats.nb + 1
145: 			if act.skeleton_minion then
146: 				stats.nb_skeleton = stats.nb_skeleton + 1
147: 				if act.skeleton_minion == "mage" then stats.has_skeleton_mage = true end
148: 				if act.skeleton_minion == "archer" then stats.has_skeleton_archer = true end
149: 			end
150: 			if act.ghoul_minion then stats.nb_ghoul = stats.nb_ghoul + 1 end
151: 			if act.lord_of_skulls then stats.lord_of_skulls = act end
152: 			if act.is_bone_giant then stats.bone_giant = act end
153: 			if act.dread_minion then stats.dread = act end
154: 			stats.list[#stats.list+1] = act
155: 		end end
156: 	else
157: 		for act, _ in pairs(game.party.members) do if act.summoner == self and act.necrotic_minion then
158: 			stats.nb = stats.nb + 1
159: 			if act.skeleton_minion then
160: 				stats.nb_skeleton = stats.nb_skeleton + 1
161: 				if act.skeleton_minion == "mage" then stats.has_skeleton_mage = true end
162: 				if act.skeleton_minion == "archer" then stats.has_skeleton_archer = true end

translation_snapshot.source:
The golem automatically reconfigures heavy mail and massive armours designed for living creatures to protect its own vital areas.
	%s armour value by %d, armour hardiness by %d%%, and provides %d%% critical hit reduction when wearing heavy mail or massive armour.
translation_snapshot.target:
傀儡学会重新组装重甲和板甲，以便更加适用于傀儡。
	当装备重甲或板甲时，%s护甲 %d 点，护甲强度 %d%%， 并且减少 %d%% 被暴击率。

translation_snapshot.source:
Sends out a surge of undeath energies into your aura.
		All minions inside gain 25%% speed for %d turns
		All non-ghoul minions are healed by %d%%.
		If you know Call of the Mausoleum, the time remaining to the next free ghoul is reduced by %d.
		if you know Corpse Explosion or Putrescent Liquefaction the duration of those effects are increased by %d.
		All non-undead foes caught inside are dazed for %d turns.
		In addition all your minions (created after you learn this spell) have a passive health regeneration.
translation_snapshot.target:
在你的光环中放出一股不死能量。
		范围内所有随从获得 25%% 速度，持续 %d 回合。
		所有非食尸鬼的随从被治疗 %d%%。
		如果你掌握陵墓召唤技能，到下一个免费食尸鬼的时间降低 %d。
		如果你掌握夺命尸爆或腐烂液化技能，这些效果的持续时间延长 %d。
		范围内所有非不死生物的敌人都会被眩晕 %d 回合。
		此外，你的所有随从（在学会该法术后制造的）获得额外被动生命回复。

translation_snapshot.source: Harness the power of the storm to incinerate your foes.
translation_snapshot.target: 使用风暴的力量焚毁你的敌人。

translation_snapshot.source: Conveyance is the school of travel. It allows you to travel faster and to track others.
translation_snapshot.target: 传送是旅行的法术学派，能让你更快地旅行并追踪他人。

translation_snapshot.source:
Hit a target for %d%% melee damage and stun it for %d turns.
		Stun chance will improve with Spellpower.
		At level 5, this attack cannot miss.
translation_snapshot.target:
以法杖击打目标，造成 %d%% 近战伤害并震慑目标 %d 回合。
		震慑概率受法术强度加成。
		在等级 5 时，此攻击必中。
